products.name: Paracetamol 500mg
products.description: A widely used pain reliever and fever reducer, suitable for mild to moderate pain and general discomfort.
products.composition: Each tablet contains Paracetamol IP 500mg. Excipients q.s.
products.usage: Take 1 tablet every 4-6 hours as needed. Do not exceed 8 tablets in 24 hours.
products.sideEffects: Generally well tolerated. Rare: nausea, rash. Discontinue and consult a doctor if symptoms persist.

products.name: Cetirizine 10mg Tablet
products.description: An antihistamine used to relieve symptoms of allergy such as sneezing, runny nose, itchy eyes and skin rashes.
products.composition: Each tablet contains Cetirizine Hydrochloride IP 10mg. Excipients q.s.
products.usage: Take 1 tablet daily, preferably in the evening, or as directed by your physician.
products.sideEffects: May cause mild drowsiness, dry mouth or headache in some users.

products.name: Amoxicillin 500mg
products.description: A penicillin-type antibiotic used to treat a wide range of bacterial infections. Dispensed only against a valid prescription.
products.composition: Each capsule contains Amoxicillin Trihydrate IP equivalent to Amoxicillin 500mg.
products.usage: Take as prescribed. Complete the full course even if symptoms improve.
products.sideEffects: May cause nausea, diarrhea or allergic reaction. Seek help if rash or swelling occurs.

products.name: Vitamin C 1000mg
products.description: A daily immunity supplement that supports antioxidant defence and general wellbeing.
products.composition: Each tablet contains Vitamin C (Ascorbic Acid) 1000mg.
products.usage: Take 1 tablet daily after a meal, or as directed by your physician.
products.sideEffects: Generally well tolerated. High doses may cause mild stomach upset.

products.name: Digital Thermometer
products.description: Fast, accurate digital thermometer for at-home temperature monitoring for the whole family.

products.usage: Place under tongue or arm for 10 seconds until the reading beeps.

products.name: Home First Aid Kit

products.name: Panadol 500mg
products.description: Fast-acting paracetamol tablets for headache, fever and general pain relief.
products.usage: Take 1-2 tablets every 4-6 hours as needed. Do not exceed 8 tablets in 24 hours.

products.name: Paracip 650
products.description: Higher-strength paracetamol for moderate pain and fever where 500mg isn't enough.

products.name: Pantoprazole 40mg
products.description: A proton-pump inhibitor used to reduce stomach acid for acid reflux and ulcers.
products.composition: Each enteric-coated tablet contains Pantoprazole Sodium equivalent to Pantoprazole 40mg.
products.usage: Take 1 tablet daily before breakfast, or as directed by your physician.
products.sideEffects: May cause headache, diarrhea or stomach pain in some users.

products.name: Levocetirizine 5mg
products.description: A once-daily antihistamine for allergy symptoms with less drowsiness than older options.

products.name: Liv-52
products.description: A herbal liver-support formula used as a general hepatoprotective supplement.

products.usage: Take 2 tablets twice daily, or as directed by your physician.
products.sideEffects: Generally well tolerated as a herbal supplement.

products.name: Loperamide 2mg
products.description: Used for the short-term relief of acute diarrhoea in adults.
products.usage: Take 2 capsules initially, then 1 after each loose stool. Do not exceed 8 in 24 hours.
products.sideEffects: May cause constipation, dizziness or dry mouth.
